Thomas’s QI Donation Guide (5.5K progress, low effort)
0 Starting currency required; Shards recommended.
Day 1 Collection 1: Begin with the Alchemist 2 guide’s first day:

Day 1 Collection 2: Delete one Tannery, build 1 Alchemist.
At this point, you can begin donating all of your goods except ropes so your actions do not fill
up. Keep the ropes, as you will need them. ​
​
Before you get a clapboard house down, donate supplies until they match coins, as alloy is the
bottleneck in my strategy.
Day 2 Collection 1: Delete 1 Tannery, build 2 Alchemists

Day 2 Collection 2: Sell 2 Tanneries, build 2 Alchemists, build 1 frame house. Sell 2 Breweries,
Build 2 Churches.

Day 3 Collection 1: Sell 3 Multistory houses, build 1 Clapboard house, build 1 Estate House,
build 1 Brewery. I recommend rushing this Clapboard house so you can start using your actions
to donate coins.

Day 3 Collection 2: Sell 2 Churches, Build 2 Doctors
​
​
Day 4 Collection 1:
Sell 1 brewery, build 1 ropery, buy 2 goods expansions, rearrange as you wish. Build 1
clapboard house and 6 estate houses

Day 4 Collection 2:
Sell 2 Churches and one tannery; build 3 Doctors

Day 5 Collection 1:
Sell 1 Church and 1 Brewery, Build 2 Doctors

Day 5 Collection 2:
Sell 1 Estate House, Sell 2 Churches, Build 2 Doctors and 1 Clapboard house.

Day 6 Collection 1:
​
Sell 2 Churches and one Brewery. Build 3 Doctors.

Day 6 Collection 2:
Final Build: Sell one brewery, build one doctor.

source: Copy of Thomas’s QI Donation Guide (5.5K progress, low effort)-compressed.pdf

title: Advanced Settlement
subtitle: Round 2+ · Middle Ages

pages.text:
Round 2+ QI Settlement
by Ace Preston
(Nerfed Pillory Addition)
Brought to you via the Gumball Rally

Basic Assumptions
Player has 1,700 Shards to start. Why this amount you may ask, we’ll simply put it
was the figure I ended up with after round 1. This is more a outline of what I plan
to do but may be useful guide for everyone.
Player can boost both QI Gold and QI Supplies at start by 270k and 30% boosts
for both from main settlement
Player has boosts to add at least 50 goods at start to allow a goods expansion to
be placed straight away.
Player can fight through few first difficulties without needing to train troops.
Those with higher boosts will get by with EMA troops and can quickly pump out
some extra if needed during a rebuild. Others may need build some HMA troops.
Wait to after collection 5 when settlement can support it easier.

Following Plan
If you are fortunate enough to get expansions free of impediments as set out in plan, count your blessings. The Reality
for most, there will be deviations from the plan layout. Key is just follow the process.
Collect Town Hall first, it is not impacted by boosts
After Collection 4, start producing your goods ready for the next expansion before reaching collection.  You can spend
all your supplies as there are no further early builds needing supplies. All future building happening after full collection.
At collection, sell housing ( multi-storey first and then estates) and build churches as you can, and advance in euphoria
stages until you get euphoria boost to 1.5. Then collect the remaining housing. Then look to add breweries to help boost
supply collection.
At rebuild,  do your best to follow plan by adding any new Tier3 buildings and then fill in rest.
Expansions together are better and offer greater utility. Any isolated or single expansions fill with buildings that will not
be sold. If you have many of these isolated expansions you may need more stock of coins/supplies and alloy to fill with
pillory at end.
If you run out of shards after collection 2, don’t fret.  Just build without speeding. Be a few tweaks required to adjust,
with biggest if you cannot speed the Doctor builds.  It might push conversion to full QA back a little (1-2 collections).

The pic shows a starting grid. It is a 4x3 expansion lot size.
Look to make it a 5x3 with first expansions. Extend whichever
way has fewest impediments.  In the pic you would extend
bottom side as the 3 expansions are free of impediments.
Guide will show everything connected as it is easier to do.
The reality is your settlement will be more broken unless you
spend extra shards.
First 3 expansions are somewhat fixed on where to take them
as they are needed to create a 5x3 space.  After that, focus
on getting expansions free of impediments to keep shard cost
low for the Round. .
The expansions are all perfect size for 4 of the 2x2 tile
housing units in expansions wherever they are and this
leaves main space for bigger buildings and the sell/build flows
that will occur.

The aim is to maximise Alloy collection and housing being
smallest footprint is the goto buildings for this purpose.
What is required for each collection not for the casual QI
player, this is for those nutters who want to put in
maximum effort.
The  layout is  shown. Buying 3 shard expansions and 1
goods expansion. This does require at least an extra 270k
gold  and at least 50 goods from boosts.
Now you may think you have just wasted all your gold.
Euphoria bonus only 0.2 so going to get bugger all alloy
and gold.  Well math to the rescue.  The gold boost is
actually huge.  While euphoria bonus is 0.2 for first
collections, the Estate Bonus is 6.6. So gold bonus is
actually 6.8 plus whatever bonus from your settlement.
That first multi-storey will sell & collect  will add 90k gold
to your coffers - the lowest you will get. You have quite a
few Multi-Storey housing, so your gold worries will quickly
be extinguished. As early buildings all just require gold to
build, you will be building and selling like a mad QI fanatic.
Alloy not quite as lucky.  So the Collection process
followed is more involved than just swiping finger madly
over the settlement and will detail it on the next slide.
Starting Settlement Build
TIP: If you are short of gold target at the start, before
building settlement, do some donating or fighting and
you might win extra gold.
Last slide has an alternate layout for those with no
gold boosts but shards to use and designed to still
get you to 1k alloy at after collection 2.

Sell 9 Multi-Storey and build 4
Churches - bonus moves to
0.6
Assuming you started with boosts outlined, you
should end up with balances of 2.1 million Gold,
395k Supplies and 534 Alloy.

8th Collection and Rebuild
(GMT Timing QI Fanatic Sunday 1800
QI Normal Diff 4-2)
Easy Path
Collect all.
Build last goods expansion.
Sell Ropery
Build 3 Multi-Storey in new space.
Sell 5 Estates, Move some Estates and Cartographer to make
space to build 3 more Brewery.
Maximalist path
(only if your guild gets to infinite nodes and you want more gold
for donations )
Collect all supplies.
Build last goods expansion
Sell Ropery
Build 3 Multi-Storey in new expansion space.
Move some Estates and Cartographer to make space
Sell all Brewery
Build 7 Churches
Build 17 Estates (leaves 2x2 blank to keep euphoria bonus at 1.5)
Collect all housing
Sell Churches and 17 Estates
Build 15 Breweries

9th Collection and Rebuild
(GMT Timing QI Fanatic Monday 0415
QI Normal Diff 5-1)
Easy Path
Collect all.
Maximalist Path
(only if your guild gets to infinite nodes and you want more gold for
donations)
Collect all supply
Sell all Brewery
Build 7 Churches
Build 17 Estates (leaves 2x2 blank to keep euphoria bonus at 1.5)
Collect all housing
Sell Churches and 17 Estates
Build 15 Breweries
At the end of collection your coffers should have 15.5m coins, 4.7m
supplies and 17,400 alloy and this will allow move to full QA during next
collection..

10th Collection and Rebuild
(GMT Timing QI Fanatic Monday 1430  QI Normal Diff 5-2)
This is last Collection before going full QA. If you are unsure you have enough
stuff or just want more spare then by all means, take as many extra collections
as you like before you go full QA.
At collection as euphoria sorted, collection can be simple or you might go with
an approach to maximise supplies being the last collection.
Simple approach is collect everything.
Maximalist approach (my preference and recommendation) is to start by
collecting all housing. Then onto the supply side.
Collect 1 Bakery, Sell the Bakery and add Brewery. Repeat this sequence until
all Bakeries have been collect. You will be able to remove some housing as you
go (but keep at least 3 Clapboards) to add even more breweries.   Then collect
your breweries
If you need use more pillory because of layout you may need an extra
collection or keep Clapboards to get alloy for them.
The pic shows 5 Clapboards as I want a bit extra Alloy for decorations at end
as plan is tight on Alloy and I wanted a bit more  just for Decorations to fill that
blue strip.

11th Collection and Rebuild
(GMT Timing QI Fanatic Tuesday 0045           QI Normal Diff 6-1)
Troop buildings are finished so train troops. After training troops
required ( I allow for 400 cannon and 100 Guard which is
generally more than I need, but you do you. ) sell the troop
buildings and clapboards and add 4 doctors and 2 Pillory.
Note that little blue strip under Town Hall I normally put some
Gargoyles (blue fighter here) for a little extra boost. If you
already have great boosts then you could swap out the 2
doctors below the strip and replace with 6 Pillory in the space.
If you need more boost then just swap out some Culture for
Decorations of your choice.
Now you will stay this way until the end of QI.
If you find yourself in last couple of hours of QI, with a full action
bank but lower than desired boosts, sell up your Culture
buildings and put down as many decorations as you can.

Estimate Output and Other Useless Info
My estimate is a return of 11,500 points and 2,020 Shards. (Assuming RNG God returns Shards
at 150 per 100 successful actions).
To get there it also assumes collection occurs on 10 hour mark with 15 minutes taken during
collection and rebuild build time until Settlement is finished. After that it is just assumed you fight
enough so your QA bar never fills to limit causing QA production to pause.
What am I rocking to get to this points total?
Main city QA boosts of 3,200 per hour.
My fighting stats are 865/765 and I like to add +105/+105 ( 7 Gargoyles) at last build point.
Fighting wise, I just auto fight with 7 Artillery and 1 Heavy infantry. Not always the best but gets
me through QI.
Hope it helps.

expansions with no boost but should be able to get 4.
At end of it all you should have 728k Coun, 125k
Supplies and 466 Coin..
